mapper.select: SELECT r.id reservation_id,i.id item_id,r.sku_id,i.prop_name_snapshot name,r.sn_id,s.sn_code,r.quantity held_quantity, r.quantity-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.quantity) FROM order_claim_stock_result f WHERE f.claim_id=c.id AND f.original_reservation_id=r.id AND f.result_status IN ('recorded','repair_pending')),0) unrecorded_quantity FROM order_claim c JOIN inventory_reservation r ON r.rental_order_id=c.rental_order_id AND r.reservation_status='disputed_holding' JOIN rental_order_item i ON i.id=r.rental_order_item_id LEFT JOIN prop_sn_instance s ON s.id=r.sn_id WHERE c.id=#{claim} AND c.claim_status IN ('submitted','admin_reviewing','supplement_required','waiting_user_response','user_appealed','executing') ORDER BY i.id,r.id

SELECT f.id,f.claim_id, f.original_reservation_id reservation_id,f.rental_order_item_id item_id,i.sku_id,f.sn_id,f.quantity,f.outcome,f.result_status status,f.recorded_by actor, f.remark,f.source_type,f.decision_id,f.created_at,f.applied_at FROM order_claim_stock_result f JOIN rental_order_item i ON i.id=f.rental_order_item_id WHERE f.claim_id=#{claim} ORDER BY f.created_at,f.id
mapper.update: UPDATE order_claim_stock_result SET result_status='replaced' WHERE id=#{id} AND claim_id=#{claim} AND result_status='repair_pending'
UPDATE order_claim SET version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_reservation(id,sku_id,sn_id,quantity,checkout_batch_id,checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id, rental_order_id,rental_order_item_id,source_type,source_id,rental_start_date,rental_end_date,occupy_start_date,occupy_end_date, reservation_status,expires_at,idempotency_key,version,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{child},sku_id,NULL,#{fact.quantity},checkout_batch_id,checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id,rental_order_id,rental_order_item_id,'order_item',rental_order_item_id, rental_start_date,rental_end_date,occupy_start_date,occupy_end_date,'completed',NULL,CONCAT('claim-part:',#{fact.id}),0,#{at},#{at} FROM inventory_reservation WHERE id=#{fact.reservationId} AND sn_id IS NULL AND reservation_status IN ('disputed_holding','renting','overdue_holding') AND quantity>#{fact.quantity}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_reservation SET quantity=quantity-#{fact.quantity},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{fact.reservationId} AND reservation_status IN ('disputed_holding','renting','overdue_holding') AND quantity>#{fact.quantity}
UPDATE order_claim_stock_result SET result_status='applied',released_reservation_id=#{release},applied_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND result_status='recorded'
UPDATE order_claim_stock_result SET result_status='repair_pending' WHERE id=#{id} AND result_status='recorded'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case WHERE id=#{id} AND case_status='closed')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim c JOIN arbitration_case a ON a.claim_id=c.id AND a.case_status='closed' WHERE c.id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim_stock_result WHERE claim_id=#{id} AND result_status='applied')
mapper.update: UPDATE order_return_check SET checked_at=#{at},closed_at=#{at},operator_user_id=#{actor},closed_by_user_id=#{actor},remaining_close_ms=NULL, auto_close_at=NULL,close_reason='索赔实物已逐项处置',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE rental_order_id=#{order} AND check_status='claim_submitted' AND claim_created=1 AND closed_at IS NULL
